chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halaby and Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who married a young girl, so his wife breast-fed her, or a mother of his child. He (peace be upon him) said: 'She is prohibited unto him'.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife's breastfeeding make her husband's young wife prohibited to him?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the prohibition of marriage via radh (breastfeeding) is established not only by the husband's direct nursing but also through his wife or the mother of his child nursing the bride, thereby extending the mahram bond to the husband. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the efficacy of indirect breastfeeding in creating permanent marital prohibitions, a key topic in fiqh al-radh. It highlights the practical application of lineage and nursing ties in defining family structure within Islamic jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, and Abdullah Bin Sinan,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who married a young girl, so his wife breast-fed her, or a mother of his child. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She is Prohibited unto him’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “About the case of a man who marries a small girl and his wife breastfeeds her or the mother of his children, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘She becomes unlawful for him.’”
